Sandbox_PhunMart_Debug_tooltip: Adds more verbose logging for debugging purposes. Only use if you know what you're doing.
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChanceToDropChange: Chance for zombies to drop coins
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChanceToDropChange_tool: The probability that a zombie will drop coins upon death.
Sandbox_PhunMart_MinCoinsToDrop_tooltip: The minimum number of cents a zombie can drop upon death.
Sandbox_PhunMart_MaxCoinsToDrop_tooltip: The maximum number of cents a zombie can drop upon death.
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChangeDropMode_tooltip: How a zombie's coin drop reaches the player. This only picks the form it arrives in: the drop chance and the min/max amounts above still apply to all three, as does any per-zone tuning from PhunZones.
Sandbox_PhunMart_WalletOnDeath: What happens to a balance on death
Sandbox_PhunMart_WalletOnDeath_tooltip: Dropped leaves a wallet on the body to be recovered, scaled by the return rate below. Kept carries the balance straight over to the next character, with nothing to walk back for. Lost wipes it. Bound pools such as tokens are restored to their allowance in all three.
Sandbox_PhunMart_WalletOnlyPickupOwn_too: If enabled, only the owner of a wallet can pick it up.
Sandbox_PhunMart_AllowWalletDrop_tooltip: If enabled, players can drop currency from their wallet as a pickupable item. Intentional drops are always pickupable by any player, regardless of the wallet pickup setting.
Sandbox_PhunMart_WalletReturnRate_toolti: The percentage of money that is returned to the player on death. 0 means no money is returned, 100 means all money is returned. Only applies when a balance is dropped on the body; the other two options have nothing to scale.
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChangeCapCents_tooltip: Maximum cents a player can carry (9999 = $99.99). At cap, coins left on the ground will not be consumed. Set to 0 for no cap.
Sandbox_PhunMart_TokenCap_tooltip: Maximum number of special tokens a player can carry. Set to 0 for no cap.
Sandbox_PhunMart_EnableChangePool_toolti: Show the change (coin) currency pool in the shop UI and wallet tab. Disabling hides it from players but does not delete balances.
Sandbox_PhunMart_EnableTokenPool_tooltip: Show the token currency pool in the shop UI and wallet tab. Disabling hides it from players but does not delete balances.
Sandbox_PhunMart_DefaultHoursToRestock_t: The default number of hours between restocking a shop. 0 would mean that (by default) the shops are only ever stocked once
Sandbox_PhunMart_DefaultNumOfHoursToReRo: How many hours before a machine becomes a different shop entirely, picked from the ones eligible where it stands. 0 means machines keep the shop they converted as. A machine waits until no player is nearby before changing.
Sandbox_PhunMart_DefaultNumOfItemsWhenRe: Default number of items to stock
How many items a shop stocks when it does not set a roll count of its own. This is the low end of a small range, so 5 stocks 5 to 8. Most shops set their own count and ignore this.
Sandbox_PhunMart_ChanceToConvert_tooltip: The chance that a vanilla vending machine will get converted to a random PhunMart machine. Set to 0 to disable
Sandbox_PhunMart_DefaultDistance_tooltip: The minimum distance between similarly grouped machines
Sandbox_PhunMart_MaxStickyItems_tooltip: Maximum number of items allowed in a sticky pool before a warning is logged. Sticky pools always show all their items in a shop. Keep this low to avoid cluttered shops.
Sandbox_PhunMart_EditorRole_tooltip: If set, only players whose role name matches this value (case-insensitive) can open the editor. Leave empty to allow all players with access to debug/admin menu (or always allow in singleplayer).
